name: trackiq-amazon-amc-ntb-products
title: TrackIQ: Amazon AMC New-to-Brand Products
summary: Uses Amazon Marketing Cloud to find which products bring new customers into a brand and which mostly sell to people who already buy it — new-to-brand share by ASIN, month by month, the gateway products worth more ad weight, the retention products that need less, and how much Sponsored Products and Display spend each group gets today.
changelog: Recommends funding any product that recruits above the median with a positive gap, not only steady gateways, adds a halo check for products with little ad spend of their own, and classifies earlier months against their own median.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
